# finance-system-webpage-public

**PUBLIC, CODE ONLY, NO FINANCIAL DATA.** The Finance System web page, served by GitHub Pages at
https://alvinoyang.github.io/finance-system-webpage-public/. Alvin opens it on his iPhone and
MacBook Air to see what is due and to enter what only he knows.

The page holds no figures and no key. It reads its data from the private repository
finance-system-mailbox-private with a key kept only in each device's browser. `config.json` here
names that repository and nothing else.

**Do not edit here.** The master copy is `webpage/` in the private repository
alvinoyang/finance-system, copied here by `python3 tools/finance-system-webpage.py deploy`. **Every GitHub Pages site of this
account shares one web address with this page**, so any of them could read what this page keeps in a
browser. Only a plain page that runs no one else's code may share it: Gloria's site (GloriaSite), as it
stood on 2026-09-14, is one. Never add a site that shows what other people type or loads outside code.

Set up 2026-09-13 under decision D-2026-09-13-01; moved here from the account DrAlvinYang on 2026-09-14,
so that it no longer shares a web address with a site that shows what colleagues type.
